# 0021 — Sum N

**Language:** C

**Difficulty:** 🟢 easy

**Tested skills:**
- for loop
- functions (pass by value)

## Task

Implement **`ex_0021_SumN`** so that it computes the sum of the integers
between **`a`** and **`b`**, both included.

## Signature

**`ex_0021_SumN`** takes two parameters, in this order: two **`int`**
bounds **`a`** and **`b`**. It returns an **`int`**.

## Examples

| Call                        | returned value |
|-----------------------------|----------------|
| **`ex_0021_SumN(1, 5)`**    | 15             |
| **`ex_0021_SumN(5, 1)`**    | 15             |
| **`ex_0021_SumN(1, 1)`**    | 1              |
| **`ex_0021_SumN(1, 100)`**  | 5050           |

## Constraints

- **`a`** and **`b`** are between **`-10000`** and **`10000`**.
